rationale: The original short thesis relied on price stalling below session VWAP ($29.35), but the last five 1-minute candles show steady higher lows and higher closes, reclaiming VWAP and pushing directly into the 5-minute 9-EMA ($29.46). Rather than waiting for the automated stop at $29.60 as upward momentum builds, closing now cuts the loss early as the resistance zone is being absorbed. A flip to long is not warranted yet because the stock remains down over 6% on heavy post-earnings distribution and is still contending with the 9-EMA overhead.
